style: clean textbook B; original editable vectors
usage: Position a figure at (x,y), uniform scale s. The external desk line belongs at y+480*s. Draw the desk after the figure to hide the bottom stroke cleanly.
Identity badges contain no visible text. Overlay A/B at transformed badgeTextAnchor using middle baseline and center alignment.
Cards contain no visible text. Overlay the selected Chinese strategy label with the project’s real SC font.
All components are native SVG paths, ellipses, circles and rectangles. No external font, image, script, filter or gradient dependencies.
The neutral back uses a native SVG pattern. Duplicate IDs are safe when loading each SVG as a separate image; prefix IDs before combining into one SVG DOM.
For animation, transform an entire figure or grouped arms/hands together. Hands are resting poses and should not be rotated independently without redrawing the forearms.

Upper sleeves are behind the torso; bent forearms, cuffs and hands are in front. Body fill keeps the original bounds, while the open body outline omits the bottom hem through the palm area. No mask/clip or downscaling conceals intersections.
The visible image begins around x=56 and y=48; preserve the full viewBox for predictable placement. Minimum recommended displayed figure width is 300 px in a 1920 px wide master.
